ease.reason: A beginner can test a tier-to-rate lookup with operator-supplied sample values; no attached source documents implementation mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: Shopify merchants may value help applying tier-specific shipping prices; this request establishes no AI-service payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map supplied tiers to draft rates, but Shopify configuration and unusual rate rules are unsupported here.

autonomy.reason: A lookup can produce repeatable draft rates; a merchant must verify eligibility, calculations and any live settings.

evidence.reason: The post names three discount tiers and asks for proper shipping pricing, but gives no rate formula or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: A tier-to-rate lookup is a bounded experiment, but the post gives no rate formula, the implementation is undocumented, and the five provisional ratings average 4.6, below threshold.
